scope: Strict TypeScript structured temporal schedule resolution and pending schedule merge with injected existing timezone primitives; own-entry weekday lookup
limits: Resolver consumes structured temporal meaning; it does not interpret natural-language phrases or decide mutation authority.
Timezone conversion/local-date primitives remain existing injected implementations, and existing invalid-context exception behavior is not redefined.
Ambiguous 12-hour selection stays on the chosen local date; if both clocks elapsed the later one is retained, with recurring advancement still owned by normalization.
Inherited weekday properties now yield INVALID_WEEKDAY rather than the prior INVALID_CALENDAR_DATE; valid weekday/timezone/calendar semantics remain compatible.
Missing inherited date yields an explicit no-op; render/date payloads are not current ownership or durable effect evidence.
No SQL/read/write/scheduler boundary changed; no new PostgreSQL fixture required.
Node 22 smoke constructs actual requests offline; not a full server boot or live schedule/calendar mutation.
No model/provider latency, price or quality measurement; no deployment or V2 activation.
